_about: Items deferred while porting earlier waves. Later porters: grep this file for your feature id (and related class names) and pick up what was handed to you.

deferred: worldgen-crash-fixes item 7 (PinchBeetle crash, upstream 4db9ecb2e): not applicable to 4.3. It fixes a recursion that the 1.20.5 port introduced (66c9a40f1); 4.3's getDimensions override is correct.

worldgen-perf-fixes, a2b9fa06b full reorganisation: moving every option into twilightforest.config.{TFConfig,TFCommonConfig,TFClientConfig,ConfigSetup} and baking all options (uncrafting, portal and client UI flags) is not ported. It is a 48-file refactor that overlaps config-option-additions (which renames and adds portal/core options) and would need SyncUncraftingTableConfigPacket rewiring. Forge 47's ConfigValue.get() already caches, so only the hot paths were baked, under 4.8's flat field names.

daa18f41a (TFMaze.resetCells via Arrays.fill + per-retry rcoords reset in HedgeMazeComponent): not applicable here, it patches the #2035 hedge-maze retry loop (542b39b36) that 4.3 lacks; apply it together with structure-bugfixes-misc

Final Castle mural eager generation in the piece constructor via WorldUtil.getOverworldSeed(): needs remove-seed-coremod; implemented as lazy one-time generation on the first postProcess plus serialization instead

TFMaze.wallBlocks (MazestoneProcessor BlockSelector) still holds a shared mutable 'next' field across Labyrinth postProcess threads. Upstream 4.8 leaves it too; the race only affects which mazestone variant is placed and cannot crash

Skull Chest fallback for a fully damaged casket (4.8 3a80ee2f4/40677a5ec/1066cc426) and 4.8's ResolvableProfile/SkullChestBlockEntity casket owner: belongs to the keepsake-casket-skull-chest feature, as the spec says. 4.3's break-and-drop behaviour is kept until then.
Config translation lang keys (config.twilightforest.totem_charm_animation): 4.3 has no config.* translations at all, so none were added and no datagen was touched.
boss-bugfixes: the d638f1787 NeoForge singleplayer in-memory packet path is not needed. Forge 47 SimpleChannel always encodes and decodes, so 4.3's FriendlyByteBuf path covers singleplayer.
boss-bugfixes: 5c8751651 (Naga crash in defineSynchedData) is a 1.20.5+ SynchedEntityData.Builder issue that does not affect 1.20.1, so it is skipped.

boss-bugfixes: 7fb35728d's `!getItemStacks().isEmpty()` guard is left out because a fixed-size NonNullList is never empty, so the check does nothing. 4.8 also skips marking the structure conquered when doMobLoot is off; only the loot gating is ported, so progression is unaffected.

flask-tracking-per-player: the 3-dose / 6-second rebalance, the FAILED_CHALLENGE damage type and overrideStackedOnOther (c3768657c, 08fe2f635, a8704024c) are left to the potion-flask-rework feature, which depends on this one.

TeleporterCache SavedData (twilightforest_teleporter_cache): left out on purpose. The spec marks it optional and says to keep 4.3's link cache, which already persists through the teleporter_cache capability.
DiagonalSpiralIteratorTests / XZQuadrantIteratorTests JUnit tests: 4.3 has no src/test source set. I checked the iterator separately with a simulation: it covers each square box exactly once.

Hydra Lair floor (26c244635): the replaceBlocksDome radii and heights are tuned to 4.8's density-function lair (eaedcd678). 4.3 still builds the lair with ChunkGeneratorTwilight.raiseHills, where the domes would bury grass blocks under a stone floor. It belongs with landmark-density-terrain.

Yeti Cave drain and lattice height (13712dc34, 37f62ed62): this patches drainWater, speleothemConfig.latticeIterator and the YetiCaveStructure density terraformer. None of these exist in 4.3, which still uses deformTerrainForYetiLair. It belongs with landmark-density-terrain and speleothem-config-datadriven.
Quest Grove dropper/ram (dd7256de6): not applicable. This was a 4.8-only regression caused by its VANILLACOPY postProcess override; 4.3 already places both.
TFMaze #2335 null-state defaults (829b19ed1 + 6fe87ebf6): left out on purpose because worldgen-crash-fixes commit c7b45c8 already ports them with identical code.

Druid hut template NBT changes in 33541897c: these only rename LootTable ids from chests/* to 4.8's root ids (see the critic note on loot-table-fixes). 4.3 places basement chests from data markers and keeps chests/*.

knight-stronghold-fixes: removing the ProgressionEvents knight-stronghold block-break workaround is deferred to progression-protection-overhaul (wave 5, e9116aa11), per critic ordering note; it is only changed to SEALEVEL - 2 here.

knight-stronghold-fixes: 64b89ff38 / 32a6db24c / e7ab1ae68 (per-piece PieceBeardifierModifier / access chamber BEARD_BOX) not applicable - 4.3 has no per-piece beardifier; belongs with custom-density-terraforming.
knight-stronghold-fixes: foundry deepslate-variant removal (262a938ab) is outside the spec and not ported.

tree-feature-bugfixes: 4.8's two-block-thick hollow/time tree roots (pen-2 RootPlacer in makeRoot) and the hollow-giant structure rewrite are content changes outside the spec; makeRoot stays 1-thick (penetrability 1).
tree-feature-bugfixes: deec8995b (canopy mushroom concurrency / WeightedListFeature) not ported; only the 46a06ef13 block-replacement fix was in scope.

Both: not boot-tested and no in-world worldgen check; needs a dedicated-server boot plus fresh-chunk inspection of a Knight Stronghold, canopy/mangrove roots, time/mining trees and large winter trees.

block-spike-fixes: the Yeti Cave stalagmite elevation fix (cfadbd358) is not applicable yet. It fixes floor stalagmites that only the 4.8 speleothem-config Yeti Cave places; the 4.3 YetiCaveComponent places hanging spikes only. Revisit with speleothem-config-datadriven.
block-spike-fixes: the HollowHillStructure mound offset (+8 to +10) in 38e3b8504 belongs to the 4.8 density-function hollow hill, which 4.3 does not have (chunkgen overhaul is excluded).

block-spike-fixes: 4.3's StalactiteReloadListener still ignores the per-stalactite 'weight' when choosing a stalactite. 4.8 fixed this with StructureSpeleothemConfig weighted lists, which belongs to speleothem-config-datadriven.
entity-gameplay-bugfixes: the LichMinion Hard-only buff gate from 29a82d83b is not ported. 4.8 HEAD reverted it in the lich rework (Speed III, no gate), so it belongs to lich-boss-rework.
entity-gameplay-bugfixes: the LichBomb flame particle direction change in 65e29df27 is a client visual, left to client-visual-fixes.

entity-gameplay-bugfixes: the moonworm queen crash fix 4fa55a769 (stop setting WATERLOGGED) is not applicable. The 4.3 CritterBlock still has the WATERLOGGED property, so setting it from the fluid state is correct here.
item-block-bugfixes: the optional 4.8 change that makes carminite_block no longer slime-like (instabreak, SLIME_BLOCK sound) was skipped on purpose; the spec calls it opinionated and optional.

item-block-bugfixes: 04d3d4a15 (#2073, ore magnet switched from forge: to c: tag namespace) does not apply to 1.20.1, so 4.3 keeps the forge: tags. The TagsUpdatedEvent cache refactor (60f02cca1/9cbd772c7) also stays out; it belongs to tree-core-particles.
client-visual-fixes: Block and Chain link spacing (39388596c) needs the Chain part entity removal (232977188). Leave it to block-and-chain-fixes.
client-visual-fixes: fire jet and smoker textures are in the asset-model-texture-fixes commit, not this one.

asset-model-texture-fixes: upstream's rename of all generated door models and the render_type additions on other doors and trapdoors in 34d409b2d were left out. They only rename model files and would churn generated assets; only the sorting door used the corrected models upstream.
all three: the datagen .cache hash files under src/generated/resources/.cache were not updated. They do not affect the jar; the next runData regenerates them.

advancement-fixes: arborist update (#1951, b78462d5e + later): it only adds criteria for blocks 4.3 lacks (8 TF trapped chests -> tf-wood-trapped-chests; drying racks; chiseled canopy bookshelf). Those features should extend DENDROLOGIST_BLOCKS in TFAdvancementGenerator and arborist.json.
compat-tags: the 8 TF trapped chests in create:chest_mounted_storage; they wait for tf-wood-trapped-chests (a TODO is left in ModdedBlockTagGenerator).

loot-table-fixes: removing music_disc_superstitious from tree_cache (4a1f0a597) belongs with fallen-trunk-structure, because 4.8 moved the disc into fallen_trunk_loot. hill_1 ore_meter and hill_2 pocket_watch entries belong to ore-meter and pocket-watch.
surface-rule-fixes: the non-surface parts of 17885617b (Highlands birch trees, dark mushglooms, Bighorn getWalkTargetValue) are outside this feature's spec and were not ported.
config-option-additions: prettifyOreMeterGui is only read by the 4.8 Ore Meter HUD (OverlayHandler), so it belongs to the ore-meter feature.

tag-driven-hooks: block tag twilightforest:ore_meter_targetable is only read by the 4.8 Ore Meter's right-click filter (and needs ROOT_ORES and the sand/gravel tags translated), so it belongs to the ore-meter feature.
tag-driven-hooks: sinister_spawner in minecraft:features_cannot_replace (from ee15cfe92). The block does not exist in 4.3, so it belongs to the sinister-spawner feature.
tag-driven-hooks: coronation_carpet in minecraft:wool_carpets (also in ee15cfe92). The block does not exist in 4.3, so it belongs to whichever feature adds the coronation carpet.

crumble-horn-recipe-additions: the #2237 entries for chiseled copper, copper bulb, grate, door and trapdoor are dropped because those blocks were added after 1.20.1. This is a permanent drop, not a deferral.

misc-data-tweaks #2077 (liveroot/root ores as ore meter targets, 9f300693b): 4.3 has no twilightforest:ore_meter_targetable tag (its NYI ore meter already counts roots and liveroot), so the ore-meter port should add #forge:ores_in_ground/root to that tag when it creates it
misc-data-tweaks #2159 (fallen leaves compostable): already in 4.3 (ComposterBlock.add(0.1F, FALLEN_LEAVES) in TwilightForestMod), no change needed

misc-data-tweaks: 4.8's switch of the TF chest recipe ingredient from the wooden-chest tag to minecraft:chest (part of 13f789b57) is deliberately not ported. 4.3 keeps forge:chests/wooden so other mods' wooden chests still work, and 4.3 has no trapped TF chests

curios-compat-fixes #1949 classloading (a312e2f9f) and the Charm of Keeping curio keep-condition: 4.3 is not affected (no Curios types in CharmEvents method signatures), and charm-system-rework (a5841f7) already moves the lookup into CuriosCompat.findAndConsumeCurio and switches keepCurios to CONSUMED_CHARM_TAG. Not duplicated here, to avoid conflicts

curios-compat-fixes: 4.8's generic CuriosCompat.isCurioEquipped/isCurioEquippedAndVisible(Predicate) refactor is not ported; it is API-only and would conflict with charm-system-rework's edits at the end of CuriosCompat

translation-refresh: translations for keys that later backported features add are not merged yet. Re-run ports/twilightforest/tools/merge_upstream_lang.py <upstream clone> after those features add their en_us keys

hollow-tree-structure, fallen-trunk-structure, camp-structure, giant-house-split: the 4.8 codec reshape was NOT ported. LandmarkStructure and ProgressionStructure keep 4.3's flat codecs, so hand-convert every 4.8 worldgen/structure/*.json: flatten decoration_clearance{} into top-level chunk_clearance_radius (float 0-8: keep 4.8's value exactly, e.g. 0.5 for hollow_tree/swamp_hollow_tree, 0 = per-piece clearance), allow_biome_surface_decorations, allow_biome_underground_decorations, allow_biome_vegetation (optional, default true; write it only when false, as datagen omits true) and adjust_structure_elevation (avoid-landmark-modifier-v2 made the flat codec accept these); flatten hint_creature{} into top-level hint_item (1.20.1 ItemStack with id/Count/tag) and hint_mob; flatten controlled_spawns{}; drop structure_icon. Only the new twilightforest:landmark and twilightforest:progression wrapper types take the nested 4.8 blocks. The 4.8 structure_set JSONs for camp, fallen_trunk and hollow_tree that use twilightforest:avoid_landmark_grid copy over unchanged.

progression-protection-overhaul / lich-tower-revamp (whichever adds ProgressionPiece): in twilightforest/command/DisplayPiecesCommand.java replace `piece instanceof TFStructureComponent shieldablePiece && shieldablePiece.isComponentProtected()` with `piece instanceof ProgressionPiece shieldablePiece && shieldablePiece.isComponentProtected()` (4.8 8eb565e12), so TwilightJigsawPiece pieces are coloured lime.

40a7f57e3 (LandmarkStructure.findValidGenerationPoint override using TFBiomeProvider.getMainBiome at the grid-tile centre) is not on 4.3; LandmarkWrappedStructure and ProgressionWrappedStructure inherit vanilla Structure.findValidGenerationPoint until it is ported.

magic-map-improvements (B07, makes ProgressionStructure extend ConquerableStructure): keep ProgressionWrappedStructure.generate() as an override and do not make ConquerableStructure.generate final. 4.3's ConquerableStructure.generate keeps the LegacyLandmarkPlacements.chunkHasLandmarkCenter gate, which would silently reject random_spread-placed wrappers in the TF dimension. The wrapper's explicit `implements CustomStructureData` then becomes redundant and may be dropped.

wrapper JSON blocks (hint_creature.hint_item, decoration_clearance, avoid_additional_structures) decode with 1.20.1's lenient optionalFieldOf: a 4.8-format hint_item (lowercase count or components) or any other parse error inside an optional block silently reads as absent instead of failing the datapack like 4.8 (DFU 8 strict optionals). Write hint_item in the 1.20.1 ItemStack format (id/Count/tag).

lich-tower-revamp: SpawnerProcessor entity_width_max is decoded and stored but cannot rescale mobs on 1.20.1 (no generic.scale attribute before 1.20.5), so 4.8 LichTowerUtil's room spawners (SpawnerProcessor.compile(2, 0.8f, ...)) would place wide mobs unshrunk in small rooms. Pick room-spawner mobs narrower than 0.8 blocks, or filter the spawn list by EntityType width in LichTowerUtil.
sinister-spawner: SpawnerProcessor only matches minecraft:spawner; add the twilightforest:sinister_spawner match (4.8 384be486c) together with that block (TODO in SpawnerProcessor).

magic-map-improvements (owns QuestGroveStructure): the Quest Grove part of 4.8 257a1d1ff (move the grove from sea level + 5 to y + 2 with the default clamped adjustForTerrain) is not ported; 4.3's fixed sea level + 5 is kept and ChunkGeneratorTwilight's arena leveller still uses sea level + 5 for the grove. If it is ported, the leveller's Quest Grove branch in ChunkGeneratorTwilight.getArenaGroundLevel must derive its height from the grove's existing start (first piece bounding box), the same way the Hedge Maze and Naga Courtyard branches do, so groves saved by 4.3 keep their arena height.
lich-tower-revamp, fallen-trunk-structure, camp-structure: 4.8 also places these with WorldUtil.adjustForTerrain (the gridLength sampler); use the overloads already in twilightforest.util.WorldUtil.
naga-courtyard-terraces: the inverted-pyramid terrain clearing above the Hedge Maze and Naga Courtyard is not part of structure-terrain-sampling.
custom-density-terraforming: ChunkGeneratorTwilight.deformTerrainForFeature now takes a RandomState and getArenaGroundLevel/arenaGroundLevels were added next to doFill; expect a textual merge there.

custom-density-terraforming (adds UtilityPiece): in twilightforest/world/components/placements/AvoidLandmarkModifier.placementIsBlocked, replace the TODO with `if (piece instanceof UtilityPiece utilityPiece && utilityPiece.allowFeatures) continue;` before the greatestAxalDistance check (4.8 7dac0cd13, ea5db78ed)

lich-tower-revamp / vegetation-placement-misc: append AvoidLandmarkModifier.checkVegetation() to PLACED_MAYAPPLE, PLACED_MUSHGLOOM_CLUSTER, PLACED_FLOWER_PLACER and PLACED_FLOWER_PLACER_ALT, and to the new patch_grass_*, dense_ferns and dense_large_ferns, as 4.8 facc450f5 does. Regenerate their placed_feature JSONs.
lich-tower-revamp: add the tfTreeCheckArea overloads taking HolderSet<Structure> structuresAllowed and pass the Lich Tower holder to the tree placements (4.8 dc6ae022a)

block-and-chain-fixes: b5953b081 block and chain model/texture rework (block_and_chain.png, SpikeBlockModel/ChainModel UVs 32x16, BlockChainGoblinModel, isAlive gate in BlockChainGoblinRenderer) not ported by block-and-chain-fixes. It is in neither the inventory nor the carryover list, and asset-model-texture-fixes and client-visual-fixes already shipped, so it needs a later client-visual follow-up. Until then the thrown block uses 4.3's blockgoblin.png and UVs, and the classic goblin renderer still draws chain links while the goblin is dying. Cosmetic only.
